description: Create, start, stop or delete a Linux virtual machine billed per minute, with its SSH key and quote. Use when the person asks for a machine, or to start, stop or delete one. Before: galon_call list_compute_instances for a vm_ id. With an app connected by OAuth, create and delete wait for a person's approval, who sets the machine's spend cap (the refusal approval_required carries the request_approval to send); the machine stops at its cap; stop is direct; start is direct until the cap is reached. Returns what the action returns: the key, the quote, or the machine and its state.

action.description: What to do: add_ssh_key (public_key, name): register an SSH PUBLIC key; quote (flavor, image): price a machine, the quote lasts 30 minutes; create (idempotency_key, name, flavor, image, ssh_key_ids, quote_id): billed per minute; start (id); stop (id): its disk is still billed; delete (id, confirm = the exact machine name): cannot be undone.

confirm.description: The exact machine name, as confirmation.

flavor.description: Machine size: vCPU and memory (disk included).

idempotency_key.description: Unique per machine. Reuse it on retry.

name.description: add_ssh_key: label shown in the console; create: host name, a-z 0-9 and -, starting with a letter.

public_key.description: One line of a .pub file: type, key and an optional comment.

quote_id.description: Quote id from quote_compute_instance (cq_..., needs compute quote access).

ssh_key_ids.description: 1 to 5 key ids from list_ssh_keys (needs compute read access) or add_ssh_key.

name: manage_compute_instance
title: Manage a virtual machine
